elements.text:
Training / evaluation contract

• Train split fits encoder and classifier; calibration split handles early stopping / temperature.
• Test split is not used during training.
• Trust target is expert helpfulness, not a broker-derived truth shortcut.
• unsafe latest_object_unsafe snapshots are excluded from trust training.
